frequency_source: frozen Method B LP FFD bank

fields.pose_id: Physical pose identifier from the case pose table
fields.path_index: Zero-based path index in the canonical trace for the pose's XY
fields.tau_s: Float64 propagation delay in seconds used to reconstruct phase
fields.delay_m: Propagation path length in meters, tau_s times c
fields.coefficients: Complex end-to-end LP port coefficients at each H bin, before propagation phase
fields.interactions: Ordered solver interaction codes, padded to max_depth with NONE
fields.objects: Ordered solver object IDs; entries with interaction NONE are padding
fields.aod_az_el_rad: World-frame departure azimuth and elevation in radians
fields.aoa_az_el_rad: World-frame arrival azimuth and elevation in radians
fields.is_los: True for the unique path without interactions
fields.frequencies_hz: Strictly increasing frequency grid in H bin order
